planSteps.description: Wait up to 60 seconds for the element with data-testid 'sankey' to appear, then wait 2 seconds for the flows to finish drawing
Press Tab repeatedly from the top of the page until the focused element has data-testid 'sankey-link'
Exactly one element with data-testid 'sankey-focus' exists, and the focused 'sankey-link' has no rectangular outline (its computed outline-style is 'none')
A tooltip data-testid 'sankey-tooltip' is visible and contains the word 'ballots'
The focused element is still a 'sankey-link' but its aria-label differs from the first one, and 'sankey-tooltip' is visible near the right half of the diagram
The focused element has data-testid 'transfer-toggle' (text 'Show transfers as a list')
